changed.item: Original says the business was started in Asheville. The edit says he currently runs it in Asheville, which shifts the claim from founding location to present location.
'bring music into people's homes' became 'put music back in people's homes', which newly implies the homes had music before.
'founder of Ruiz Piano Restoration' became 'I run Ruiz Piano Restoration'. 'I started it in 2011' still preserves the founding, but the explicit founder title is gone.
